recipe.title: Pork loin stir-fry with broccoli and carrot
steps: Cook the rice in water and let it cool. Store in 3 portions.
Slice the pork loin into thin strips. Cut the broccoli into florets and slice the carrot thin.
Stir-fry the pork in a hot pan with the oil for 4 minutes. Take it out.
Stir-fry the carrot and broccoli with the garlic for 5 minutes, then add the pork, soy sauce and ginger.
Store the stir-fry and rice in 3 boxes. Reheat in the microwave at work.
